motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have explicit hover states altering background opacity or text color.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out' for smooth, luxurious feel.
motion_and_interactions.micro_animations: Cards lift slightly on hover ('-translate-y-1'). Borders glow slightly by increasing opacity.

testing_attributes.requirement: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

hero_landing.description: Modern dark interior with architectural lighting
hero_landing.usage: Public landing page hero background (needs dark overlay bg-black/50)

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Always use dark mode. There is no light mode. Force dark styles by default.
CRITICAL: Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their backgrounds and borders to match the dark luxury palette (#0A0A0B base, #141416 surface).
Replace generic fonts. Configure tailwind.config.js to load 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) for marketing/editorial headers and 'Manrope' (sans) for UI/Dashboard interfaces.
Use lucide-react for all icons, keeping stroke widths delicate (1.5px or 1px).
Implement the Layout Grids strictly: Use CSS Grid with generous gaps (gap-6 or gap-8) to ensure the interface breathes.
Ensure the Tenant Dashboard sidebar mimics the Vercel/Linear feel but with warm dark tones.
DO NOT use raw HTML components for interactive logic (dropdowns, dialogs, tabs). ALWAYS rely on Shadcn/Radix components styled appropriately.
